description: This file defines the 'ReviewerRating' entity class in the OrangeHRM system, representing a reviewer's rating of performance, including properties such as rating, comment, associated performance review, reviewer, and KPI. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: ReviewerRating
classes.description: Entity class representing the reviewer rating for performance reviews with properties for rating, comment, related review, reviewer, and KPI, managed via Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Returns the rating value as a string or null.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the rating.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the rating.

methods.name: setPerformanceReview
methods.description: Associates a PerformanceReview entity with this rating.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Returns the Reviewer entity who provided the rating.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Sets the Reviewer entity for this rating.

methods.name: getKpi
methods.description: Returns the associated Kpi entity, if any.

methods.name: setKpi
methods.description: Associates a Kpi entity with this rating.
